thread:
jess: FYI escalation from AcmeRetail — dedicated pool didn't scale during a flash spike this morning, customer saw sustained 429s and long tail 504s. They claim minReplicas=2 but observed only 2 pods and queuing for ~11 minutes. Attaching repro + logs they captured.

jess: repro steps they gave:
1) hit /v1/generate with 8 concurrent clients using our SDK at ~120 rps total for ~10m
2) request sizes ~512 tokens, streaming on
3) got 429s start ~2026-03-17T09:12:05Z, throttled until 09:23

jess: customer logs (redacted):
```
[2026-03-17T09:12:06Z] probe: send probe id=pr-9012 route=/dedicated/acme-retail-01
[2026-03-17T09:12:06Z] registry: pull image acme/model:v2 -> 429 Too Many Requests (auth rate-limit)
[2026-03-17T09:12:08Z] warmpool: attach attempt=3 -> backoff 12s
[2026-03-17T09:15:12Z] autoscaler: desired=8, current=2, scaling_inhibited=true reason=probe_backoff
[2026-03-17T09:20:01Z] attach: timeout waiting for pod ready -> queueing requests
```

jess: they also sent an example curl used for repro (SDK equivalent):
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"acme-retail-02","input":"...","stream":true}'
```

sam-support: thx jess. marking sev2 and pinging eng-platform. Do we have probe_id/pr-9012 logs on our side? Also customer reported their registry auth rotates frequently — could be interplay with imagepull auth rotation.

lia-eng: looking. I can already see autoscaler bumped desired but refused to create more replicas because attach probes were failing (probe backoff state). We're seeing repeated registry 429s around 09:12-09:18 in the region.

lia-eng: quick dump from control plane (sanitized):
```
autoscaler[event]: desired_replicas=8 current_replicas=2 reason=probe_backoff
warmpool[event]: attach_failure count=5 error="imagepull: 429 auth rate limit"
attach-manager: backoff_window=15s last_failure=2026-03-17T09:16:40Z
```

lia-eng: hypothesis: image registry auth rotation + concurrent probe concurrency caused pull-token rate limits -> attach fails -> autoscaler logic flips a safety flag (scaling_inhibited) until probes succeed (to avoid flapping). That prevents scaleup until backoffs recover.

ops-bot: [alert] ticket #CS-4521 created; runbook invoked: dedicated-scaling-warmpool. Assigned -> lia-eng, sam-support.

mike-ml: could noisy neighbor (large model downloads) exacerbate this? If multiple tenants pull big images simultaneously we might saturate the registry quota. Check recent rollout activity in that timeframe.

lia-eng: checked — there were two other customers doing large model pulls in the same region earlier, and a scheduled model rollout for internal testing at 09:10. So registry QPS spike is plausible.

sam-support: customer impact: they saw 11m of degraded throughput, marketing campaign hit. Customer asking for mitigation and what we did.

anna-cs: I'll coordinate the customer comms. Immediate ask: can we give them a short-term mitigation (bump minReplicas or warm pool) and a timeline for root cause?

lia-eng: mitigation plan applied at 09:27: temporarily increased minReplicas=6 for acme-retail-01 and triggered manual warmpool prefetch of image. Also we requested registry quota raise from partner (in progress).

lia-eng: long term fixes: 1) make attach backoff policy more permissive when desired_replicas >> current_replicas (fail open for emergencies) 2) improve probe token refresh staggering during auth rotations 3) add telemetry for concurrent imagepulls per-region to detect noisy neighbor.

jess: noted. Sam/Anna can you confirm customer ok with temporary minReplicas bump and share ETA once registry quota reply? I'll leave postmortem/open follow-up for the infra team.

sam-support: customer accepted temporary bump and wants POA. ETA for registry quota is 48h, will escalate partner support. Adding postmortem to backlog. :white_check_mark:

anna-cs: I'll send the customer a summary and offer a dedicated capacity review; they'll likely be open to a reserved burst contract.

lia-eng: leaving an action item: ENG-PLAT-742 — change autoscaler inhibit logic to include explicit emergency override and add an opt-in flag per-customer.

jess: thanks all, closing this Slack thread — will update when postmortem draft ready.
